description: The file fails a full decode (ffmpeg reports errors or no frames decode)
Average brightness under 5 with almost no contrast (dead feed or lens cap)
Average brightness under 35 on a 0-255 scale
More than 25% of pixels clipped to white
Median frame sharpness (variance of the Laplacian) under 4 and under half of the same camera's typical sharpness
Average frame-to-frame change under 0.05 while the picture isn't black
Byte-identical to an earlier clip (same SHA-256); the earliest copy is kept
Frames line up one-for-one with an earlier clip: aligned pixel difference of 0.08 or less, and under 0.62 of the difference between non-matching frames
